coverage.reason: Covers per-sub-fund ICAV accounts and AGM dispensation, and umbrella accounts and an AGM for the investment plc.
Does not state that the ICAV can elect partnership treatment or that the investment plc is per-se corporate for US tax.

local_error: “it must also prepare audited entity-level annual accounts” — the supplied evidence says the ICAV can file accounts per sub-fund and has its own statute, with most company accounting rules not applying; it does not support this asserted requirement.
rationale: Point 1 is covered, but point 2 is omitted. The unsupported entity-level accounts claim is a material local error, capping the grade at partial.
